test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 1 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The second number in the given number pairs is obtained by performing certain mathematical operations on the first number. The same operations are performed in all the options except one pair. Find the odd one out.
solution:
**Logic : When the digits of the first number are written in the descending order, second number is obtained.**

Lets check each option:

1) 4612-6412

⇒ When the digits of the first number are written in the descending order, 6421 is obtained. But 6421 ≠ 6412.

2) 7938-9873

⇒ When the digits of the first number are written in the descending order, 9873 is obtained.

3) 5286-8652

⇒ When the digits of the first number are written in the descending order, 8652 is obtained.

4) 8734-8743

⇒ When the digits of the first number are written in the descending order, 8743 is obtained.

So **"4612-6412"** is the odd one out.

Hence,** 'option 1'** is the correct answer.
